title: Find the outlier feature dimensions
goal:
Section 3.2 defines the outlier set $O$ as the feature dimensions `h` of the hidden state `X` (shape `s x h`) that hold at least one value with a large magnitude. The paper uses a threshold of `alpha = 6.0`, and Section 4.1 words the test as "at least 6.0".

Write `outlier_dims(X, alpha=6.0)`. It returns a sorted `int` array of the column indices `i` where `max(abs(X[:, i])) >= alpha`.

The page's example finds a single outlier column, with index 1, in a 3 x 4 matrix.
hints: A feature is a column of `X`, so reduce over the token axis (`axis=0`).
One large value in one token is enough to put a column in `O`. Use a maximum, not a mean.
Outliers can be negative. Take `np.abs` before the maximum.
`np.where(mask)[0]` returns the indices of the `True` entries, in increasing order.
